what: a 3 mm chamfer on the bottom long edge of a bar joined on top of a pin, where the chamfer is wider than the 2 mm gap between that edge and the pin
method: pin R8 x 30 (z 0..30) under a bar 100x20x15 (x -50..50, y -10..10, z 30..45). The chamfer of the bar bottom long edge (y=-10, z=30) removes the triangle 3 x 3 along the whole 100 mm: 450. All of it is inside the bar (z>=30); the pin lies below z=30, so it is untouched and only uncovers a strip of its top: V = pi*64*30 + 30000 - 450 = 35581.858. The result must be a closed solid (the strip of the pin top becomes a face).
